results.segment: We are writing about your policy renewal for information only. There is nothing you need to send us.

obligations.ask: Arrange for someone to be present

results.segment: Should you be away on the date shown, arrange for someone to be present.
If you pay by standing order rather than direct debit, update the amount yourself.
Keep pets in another room while the engineer is working.
Take care on the pavement while the works are in progress.
If you have already attended a review this year, please tell us the date so that a second is not arranged.
If you have already provided your nomination form, please contact us so we can check it was received.
Our offices will be closed from 24 December to 2 January, though the online account remains available.
